activity_summary: During the second act you were behind the traverse, where you had been since the tale. A hired man could not find his roll in Garnish's chest. You stayed in the chest with him until the right one came up, and you did not rehearse your nerves out loud. Sixty rolls had gone into the chest. The hall went on laughing at the old play. You did not improve it from the tiring-room.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed in the chest until the right roll was in the man's hand, and then went back behind the cloth.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept Friday and Saturday off Sunday's paper, and shut the lid.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Sent the wrong roll back, and kept the laugh from being improved.

entities.name: Queen Elizabeth
entities.context: Not in the tiring-room. The hall beyond the cloth was hers to laugh in.

facets.activity: Found the right roll in Garnish's chest

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sixty went into the chest, and a roll does not leave a chest by itself.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Sunday is the old book. Do not crown a man out of Friday.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: They are laughing at a thing that is already made.

quotes.speaker: (the hired man)
quotes.text: This is the one. I know the first word.
